completedWork: triage-modes.test.js (24 tests): AC3 unset and empty key (deep-equal, stub count 0); AC4 (a)-(l) plus a non-following 3xx stub, each 200 fallback with the mapped reason and exactly one fetch call; (m) enum normalisation; (n) thinking-first; response/health/outbound model equal the configured model even when the upstream body names another (t04 note); AC13 never() returns timeout within 300+500 ms and the signal is aborted; live mode with real fetch against fake-anthropic (C7 headers/path); AC4(o) 307 and 308 with real fetch: fallback model_error, A count 1, B count 0; PL-3 `npm run eval:tune` exits 0 or 1, no ECCODE_EVAL, last line TUNE_EVAL mode tune. redaction-egress.test.js (4 tests): oracle self-check; AC16 + ARCH-10 probes via capture stub and on the wire via fake-anthropic: (a) brief list + phone fragments absent, raw </ticket> appears only as the wrapper delimiter (and in the constant system prompt), (b) digit tokens, (c) independent hasLuhnWindow, (d) placeholders, (e) no < > between delimiters, (f) controls kept; injectionSuspected equals detector on original; logs carry counts not content; fallback after invalid_output never echoes content. privacy.test.js (5 tests): fallback spawn with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY '' and parent ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/TRIAGE_ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL set (restored in finally) -> mode fallback, baseUrlCustom false; second isolation case with an empty test env (child env is exactly PATH+PORT); ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL ignored (spawned and in-process: outbound URL stays https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages via stub); live spawn against fake-anthropic with upstream bodies echoing the marker and key: no marker/key/base URL in stdout/stderr, no key in any response body/header, configured model reported, upstreamStatus logged as metadata. No product defects found.
